name: pico-progress-feedback-live-ab
description: Two focused live-model tasks frozen before evaluation: pytest tail localization and recovery after repeated unchanged tool calls.

tasks.prompt: Run exactly `pytest -q -s`. The test intentionally prints a long noise prefix before failing. From the visible run_shell result, write the exact failing pytest node id, without the leading FAILED status word, to answer.txt. Do not guess a name that is not visible in the tool result. Then submit a final answer.

Follow this recovery protocol exactly. Call list_files with path `.` repeatedly without changing its arguments. If the result begins with `error:`, repeat the identical call and do nothing else. If the result does not contain `progress_nudge:`, also repeat the identical call. Only after a result contains `progress_nudge:` may you switch strategy: write exactly `recovered` to recovery.txt and then submit a final answer. Never write recovery.txt before seeing that marker.
